subject.title: [Feature]: Self-hosted STT/TTS provider support in webchat (Route webchat TTS through the gateway instead of browser Speech API)

question: Should WebChat voice support be split into separate Gateway-backed read-aloud and editable batch-dictation tracks, with `tools.media.audio` as the STT config source instead of adding `messages.stt`?
rationale: The source shows backend primitives exist, but the user-visible WebChat flows require a product decision about split scope, fallback semantics, and provider credential boundaries before automation should open another broad fix PR.

options.title: Split and keep this umbrella
options.body: Use this issue to track the combined WebChat voice-provider goal while reviewing the read-aloud and dictation PRs as separate slices.

options.title: Make dictation canonical elsewhere
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98026 as the STT canonical item and narrow this issue to Gateway-backed read-aloud only.

options.title: Defer WebChat provider voice
options.body: Pause both slices until maintainers choose whether realtime Talk should replace editable dictation and per-message read-aloud.

recommendation.title: Split and keep this umbrella
recommendation.body: Use this issue to track the combined WebChat voice-provider goal while reviewing the read-aloud and dictation PRs as separate slices.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current TTS Gateway primitive and the open WebChat read-aloud PR, and are best positioned to choose the split with the existing dictation work.
